name: What are the most popular countertop materials?
description: Popular countertop materials include quartz, granite, marble, and butcher block, each offering different benefits in durability, appearance, and maintenance.

mainEntity.name: What are the most popular countertop materials?

acceptedAnswer.text: Popular countertop materials include quartz, granite, marble, and butcher block. Quartz is highly durable and non-porous, making it resistant to stains and bacteria. Granite offers a natural, unique look and is very heat resistant. Marble provides a luxurious aesthetic but requires more maintenance due to its porosity. Butcher block adds warmth and is ideal for food preparation, though it needs regular oiling.
